609 likes, 13 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 10, 2026: "9 days. 9 recipes. 9 ways to make Navratri delicious. ✨

Recipe 3 is Makhana Kheer - creamy, comforting aur delicately sweet. Makhana, shakarkand, milk aur elaichi ka simple combination, jo har festive meal ko bana de thoda aur special. ✨

Ingredients:

¾ cup puffed lotus seeds (makhane)
1 large sweet potato (shakarkand), peeled and thickly grated
2 tbsps ghee
2 tbsps chopped cashew nuts
2 tbsps chopped almonds
3 cups milk
¼ tsp green cardamom powder
½ cup sugar
Slivered almonds for garnish

Method:

1. Heat ghee in a kadai. Add puffed lotus seeds and sauté till golden brown and crisp. Transfer in a plate and set aside.
2. Sauté cashew nuts and almonds in the same pan till golden brown. Drain and set aside.
3. Add sweet potato and sauté for 5-6 minutes on medium heat. Add milk, cover and cook for 8-10 minutes.
4. Transfer the puffed lotus seeds in a mortar and crush coarsely with a pestle.
5. Add to the pan. Add fried nuts, green cardamom powder and sugar and cook till sugar melts.
6. Transfer in individual serving bowls, garnish with almonds and serve warm.

Save this recipe for when you’re craving something sweet and comforting!

#SanjeevKapoor #NavratriRecipes #MakhanaKheer #IndianDesserts #FestiveRecipes

(Makhana Kheer, Makhana Dessert, Kheer Recipe, Indian Sweets, Festive Desserts)".

1,963 likes, 15 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 9, 2026: "9 days. 9 recipes. 9 ways to make Navratri delicious. ✨

Recipe 2 is Hariyali Chaas - cool, refreshing and full of fresh flavours. A simple blend of yogurt, coriander, green chillies and ginger, finished with a sprinkle of roasted cumin.

Ingredients:
• 8–10 fresh coriander sprigs
• 1 cup yogurt
• 2 green chillies, stemmed
• ½ inch ginger, roughly chopped
• Rock salt to taste
• ½ tsp roasted cumin powder + extra to sprinkle
• 6–8 ice cubes 

Method:
Blend yogurt, green chillies, coriander, ginger, rock salt and roasted cumin powder until smooth.
Transfer to a bowl, add 1 cup water and ice cubes, and mix well. Pour into glasses, sprinkle with roasted cumin powder and serve chilled. ✨

Save this recipe and stay tuned for the next one!

#SanjeevKapoor #NavratriRecipes #HariyaliChaas #IndianCooking #EasyRecipes

(Hariyali Chaas, Chaas Recipe, Refreshing Drinks, Navratri Recipes, Indian Cooking)".

401 likes, 16 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 8, 2026: "9 days. 9 recipes. 9 delicious chapters of Navratri. ✨

Today’s chapter is Samo Pulao - a wholesome, flavour-packed meal made with barnyard millet, seasonal vegetables, crunchy cashews and fresh coriander.
Simple ingredients, easy steps and a delicious bowl of comfort. Here’s how to make it:

Ingredients:
• 1½ cups barnyard millet (samo), washed and drained
• 2 tbsp ghee
• 1 tsp cumin seeds
• 1 inch ginger, chopped
• 2–3 green chillies, slit
• 4–5 cashew nuts, halved
• 1 medium tomato, diced
• 1 medium carrot, diced
• 100 g pumpkin, diced
• 100 g yam, diced
• ½ cup blanched green peas
• Rock salt to taste
• 2 tbsp fresh coriander, chopped
• Fresh coriander sprig for garnish 

Method:
1. Heat ghee in a non-stick kadai. 
2. Add cumin seeds, followed by ginger and green chillies. Sauté for a minute. Add cashews, tomato, carrot, pumpkin, yam and green peas. Mix well.
3. Add the barnyard millet and mix. Pour in 3 cups of water, add rock salt and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover and cook for 10–12 minutes.
4. Finish with fresh coriander, garnish and serve hot. ✨

Save this recipe and tell us what should be the next chapter!

#SanjeevKapoor #NavratriRecipes #SamoPulao #MilletRecipes #IndianCooking

(Samo Pulao, Barnyard Millet, Millet Recipes, Navratri Recipes, Indian Cooking)".

695 likes, 18 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 3, 2026: "Kabhi kabhi, ek simple twist se familiar favourite ban jaata hai something completely new.

This Sitaphal Bhapa Doi brings together the creamy texture of baked yoghurt with the natural sweetness of sitaphal - a perfect combination of comfort and freshness.

Ek familiar fruit, ek naya andaaz - and a delicious way to enjoy sitaphal this season.

Ingredients

½ cup custard apple (sitaphal) pulp
½ cup yogurt
½ cup condensed milk
½ cup fresh cream
Edible flowers for garnish

Method

1. Heat sufficient water in a steamer. 
2. Take yogurt in a bowl. Add condensed milk, fresh cream and custard apple pulp and mix well.
3. Transfer the mixture in individual earthen bowls and cover with aluminium foil. Arrange in steamer basket and steam for 8-10 minutes.
4. Allow to cool completely and refrigerate for 2-3 hours.
5. Garnish with edible flowers and serve.

#SanjeevKapoor #SitaphalBhapaDoi #IndianDesserts #EasyDesserts #SeasonalRecipes".

1,231 likes, 16 comments - sanjeevkapoor on October 3, 2026: "The chilli oil that makes everything better.
Ghar pe bana hua, packed with heat, flavour aur that perfect little crunch.

Noodles ho, dumplings ho, rice ho ya simple sa toast - bas ek spoon chilli oil, aur flavour game ho jaaye next level.

Ek jar banao. Har cheez mein daalo.

Ingredients

4 tbsps red chilli flakes
½ cup oil
1 tbsp stock cube powder
1 tbsp white sesame seeds
1 tsp crushed black peppercorns
1½ tbsps chopped garlic
1 tbsp castor sugar
1-inch cinnamon stick
1 bay leaf
2 star anise
4-5 coriander stems
1 medium onion, cut into quarters
1 tsp salt
½ tbsp dark soy sauce

Method

1. Take red chilli flakes in a bowl. Add stock cube powder, white sesame seeds, crushed black peppercorns, garlic and castor sugar.
2. Heat oil in a shallow nonstick pan.  Add cinnamon, bay leaf, star anise, coriander stems and onion and cook till onion turns golden brown.
3. Strain the hot oil directly in the bowl in which all the ingredients are added and mix well.
4. Add salt, dark soy sauce and mix well. Allow to cool.
5. Store in airtight jar and use as required.

#SanjeevKapoor #ChilliOil #HomemadeRecipes #IndianCooking #CookingHacks".
